scientific_scope.main_question: Does measured 5-prime MFE add fixed-protein expression signal beyond CAI, CDS GC and CDS GC3 under exact-CDS-grouped out-of-fold evaluation?
scientific_scope.tagged_question: Within the same CDS, does the expression change after adding the 5-prime leader track the measured 5-prime MFE change in the accessibility direction?
scientific_scope.delta_CAI_or_delta_GC_reason: The tagged sheet lacks CAI and tagged nucleotide sequence. Its codon frequencies are conditional within amino acids and do not reconstruct overall tagged GC.

main_analysis.aggregation: One row per exact CDS; target is the arithmetic mean of log10_expression across replicate seqIds. CAI, MFE and sequence-derived features must be identical within a group.

feature_derivation.gc_cds: (G+C count)/720 over the CDS including terminal stop
feature_derivation.gc3_cds: fraction of third codon positions that are G or C over all 240 codons including terminal stop

ridge.pipeline: StandardScaler fit on training rows only, then Ridge(alpha=1.0)

main_analysis.null_model: Training-fold mean target; descriptive reference only
main_analysis.outer_cv: Five-fold KFold(shuffle=true, random_state=seed) on 150 aggregated exact-CDS rows. Each repeat produces one out-of-fold prediction per group for every model and feature set.
main_analysis.effects: structure minus simple for Spearman; simple MSE minus structure MSE for MSE, so positive always favors adding 5-prime MFE

inference.effect_summary: Mean and median across the 10 seed-level OOF effects
inference.confidence_interval: Two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over the 10 seed-level effects, 20000 resamples, seed 20261201
inference.p_value: Exhaustive two-sided sign-flip test on the 10 paired seed effects using the mean effect statistic; all 1024 sign patterns including observed
inference.multiplicity: Holm across the four primary tests

main_analysis.pass_rule: For every primary endpoint: mean effect > 0, at least 8/10 seed effects > 0, bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0, and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
main_analysis.interpretation: Pass supports a development-only fixed-protein 5-prime-structure increment under these frozen models. It is not protein OOD, functional untouched, RK-G1 or SOTA evidence.

tagged_analysis.aggregation: Compute per-seqId tagged-minus-main differences, then average differences within exact CDS.

differences.delta_mfe5: tagged rnaEnergy_-4..37 minus main rnaEnergy_-4..37; positive means weaker predicted 5-prime structure

tagged_analysis.adjusted_endpoint: OLS coefficient of delta_mfe5 in delta_log10_expression ~ delta_mfe5 + main CAI + main gc_cds + main gc3_cds, expected positive

inference.spearman_permutation: Two-sided permutation of delta_mfe5 across 71 groups, 100000 permutations plus observed, seed 20261202
inference.adjusted_coefficient_permutation: Two-sided permutation of delta_mfe5, residualizing permuted predictor and outcome against intercept + main CAI/GC/GC3, 20000 permutations plus observed, seed 20261203
inference.confidence_interval: Paired group bootstrap with 20000 resamples for both endpoints, seed 20261204
inference.multiplicity: Holm across the two tagged endpoints

tagged_analysis.pass_rule: Both endpoints positive, both bootstrap 95% CIs exclude 0, and both Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
tagged_analysis.interpretation: Pass supports paired 5-prime structure-expression coupling in this development subset. Because the leader changes more than MFE and tagged sequence is unavailable, it is not a sole-cause claim or generator authorization.
